items.explanation: Asian shares mein thodi recovery dekhne ko mili hai, halanki AI concerns aur naye US tariffs ka darr abhi bana hua hai. Wednesday ko Nvidia ka stock 3.9% gir kar $149.30 par band hua. Yeh stock apne October peak ke $243.37 se lagbhag $2.3 trillion peeche chal raha hai.

items.title: Stocks to watch: LG Electronics, Siemens Energy, Wipro, sugar stocks

items.explanation: Aaj trading ke dauran LG Electronics, Siemens Energy, Wipro aur sugar stocks focus mein reh sakte hain. US ne Indian goods par 25 percent tak ke tariffs lagane ka prastav rakha hai. Is faisle ke chalte textiles, shrimp exporters aur gems and jewellery sectors par investors ki gehri nazar bani rahegi.

Monday ke correction ke baad aayi tezi se pata chalta hai ki market mein buying interest barkarar hai. Halanki aane wale dino mein thode consolidation ki sambhavna se inkar nahi kiya ja sakta.

items.explanation: Jatin Gedia ka manna hai ki Nifty apne all-time high 26,373 tak pahunch sakta hai aur aage 26,600 tak badh sakta hai. 26,600 ke level par daily upper Bollinger band ka resistance mojood hai. Iske sath hi unhone Ceat samet teen stock ideas par nazar rakhne ki baat kahi hai.

items.title: Green Aero raises $14 million to develop jet engines and combat drones
items.rss_summary: Crane Ventures leads the Series A funding round as the Bengaluru-based startup expands its engine testing facilities and develops autonomous aircraft for military and commercial markets
items.hinglish_title: Bengaluru ke Green Aero ne jet engines aur drones ke liye jutaye $14 million
items.explanation: Bengaluru-based startup Green Aero ne Series A funding round mein 14 million dollars ka fund jutaya hai. Is round ko Crane Ventures ne lead kiya hai. Company is paiso ka istemal engine testing facilities badhane aur military wa commercial markets ke liye autonomous aircraft banane mein karegi.

items.title: Cognizant in talks to take over parts of S&P Global's Capital IQ operations
items.rss_summary: Cognizant is in talks to take over data and operations staff from S&P Global's India GCC, with around 1,500 employees potentially moving to the IT services firm's payroll.
items.hinglish_title: Cognizant Kar Sakti Hai S&P Global Ke Capital IQ Ka Kaam Takeover
items.explanation: Cognizant abhi S&P Global ke India GCC se data aur operations staff lene ke liye baat kar rahi hai. Is deal ke tehat lagbhag 1,500 employees IT services company ke payroll par shift ho sakte hain. Abhi is acquisition ko lekar baatcheet chal rahi hai.

items.title: Now, Noel wants revision of Tata Sons board agenda, pushes restructuring
items.rss_summary: After seeking a change in the board meeting date, Noel Tata has asked Tata Sons to prioritise discussions on an alternative restructuring plan to keep the holding company privately held
items.hinglish_title: Noel Tata Ne Maanga Tata Sons Board Agenda Me Badlaav
items.explanation: Board meeting ki date badalwane ke baad ab Noel Tata ne Tata Sons se agenda par dobara gaur karne ko kaha hai. Unhone ek alternative restructuring plan par charcha ko priority dene ki maang ki hai. Iska maksad holding company ko privately held rakhna hai.

items.title: Too silent? Built to whisper, EVs look to mimic the growl of gas engines
items.rss_summary: Automakers are using customised sounds to give EVs a distinct identity, from sporty engine-like growls to quieter cabin experiences.
items.hinglish_title: Electric Gaadiyon Me Ab Milegi Petrol Engine Jaisi Awaaz
items.explanation: Car companies ab electric vehicles ko alag pehchan dene ke liye customized sounds ka use kar rahi hain. Inme sporty engine jaisi aawazein shamil hain. Saath hi cabin ke experience ko shaant aur behtar banane par bhi dhyan diya ja raha hai.

items.title: Look past grey market hype, focus on fundamentals when applying for IPOs
items.rss_summary: Sebi has cautioned against relying on unofficial grey market premiums to gauge IPO listing gains, urging investors to assess subscription data, valuations and company fundamentals.
items.hinglish_title: IPO Me Grey Market Ke Chakkar Me Na Padein: Sebi Ki Salah
items.explanation: Sebi ne investors ko unofficial grey market premium (GMP) par zyada bharosa na karne ki chetavni di hai. Market regulator ka kehna hai ki IPO lagane se pehle subscription data, company valuations aur fundamentals ko dekhna zaroori hai. Sirf listing gains ke hype me faisla lene se bachein.

items.title: Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three data centres in Assam
items.rss_summary: The three data centres in Guwahati, Jorhat and Silchar will have a combined capacity of 40 MW and could be operational by 2028, with land already available for all three facilities
items.hinglish_title: Bharti Airtel Assam Me Lagayegi ₹1,200 Crore Ke Teen Data Centres
items.explanation: Bharti Airtel Assam ke Guwahati, Jorhat aur Silchar me teen naye data centres banane par ₹1,200 crore invest karegi. In centres ki kul capacity 40 MW hogi aur ye 2028 tak shuru ho sakte hain. Teenon facilities ke liye zameen pehle se uplabdh hai.

items.title: APL Apollo deal: Working on stakeholders' concerns, says Tata Steel CEO
items.rss_summary: "We've heard all the noise from the market... and we've addressed a lot of it (shareholder concerns) yesterday," said T V Narendran, CEO & MD, Tata Steel
items.hinglish_title: APL Apollo Deal: Tata Steel CEO Bole, Stakeholders Ki Concerns Par Kaam Jari
items.explanation: Tata Steel ke CEO aur MD T V Narendran ne bataya ki market aur shareholders ki taraf se aaye concerns par dhyan diya gaya hai. Unhone kaha ki kaafi saare muddo ko pehle hi address kar diya gaya hai. Company stakeholders ki baaton ko dhyan me rakhkar aage badh rahi hai.

items.title: Rupee bucks Asian trend, hits nearly nine-month high of 92.24 per dollar
items.rss_summary: FPI flows and cheaper oil lift rupee 0.73% to 92.24/$
items.hinglish_title: Rupee Me Mazbooti, Dollar Ke Khilaaf 92.24 Par Pahuncha
items.explanation: FPI inflows aur kachhe tel ki girti keematon ke chalte Indian rupee 0.73% mazboot hua hai. Iske saath hi rupee dollar ke mukable lagbhag nau mahine ke high level 92.24 par pahunch gaya. Rupee ne baki Asian currencies ke mukable behtar performance dikhaya.

items.title: Jindal Steel eyes ₹15,000 crore investment by 2035, targets coated steel
items.rss_summary: The company plans to raise steelmaking capacity from 15.5 mtpa to 20 mtpa and tap demand for coated steel from infrastructure, warehousing and industrial construction
items.hinglish_title: Jindal Steel Karega ₹15,000 Crore Ka Investment, 2035 Tak Ka Plan
items.explanation: Jindal Steel ne 2035 tak ₹15,000 crore ke investment ka plan banaya hai. Company apni steelmaking capacity ko 15.5 mtpa se badhakar 20 mtpa karna chahti hai. Iske alawa infrastructure aur warehousing sector se coated steel ki badhti maang par bhi focus kiya ja raha hai.

items.title: India's net FDI turns negative in September, records $4.9 billion outflow
items.rss_summary: Higher repatriation and outward investments weighed on net FDI in September, even as net inflows during the first half of FY27 rose to $8.8 billion from $7.4 billion a year ago
items.hinglish_title: September Me India Ka Net FDI Negative, $4.9 Billion Ka Outflow
items.explanation: September mahine me zyada repatriation aur outward investments ki wajah se India ka net FDI negative ho gaya. Is dauran $4.9 billion ka outflow record kiya gaya. Halanki, FY27 ke pehle half me net inflows badhkar $8.8 billion ho gaya, jo pichle saal isi dauran $7.4 billion tha.

items.title: NRI deposit inflows jump to $125.6 billion in April-September period
items.rss_summary: FCNR(B) deposits attracted inflows of $123.75 billion in the first half of FY27, aided by the RBI's concessional swap window and attractive interest rates offered by banks
items.hinglish_title: April-September Me NRI Deposits Badhkar $125.6 Billion Par Pahunche
items.explanation: FY27 ke first half me NRI deposit inflows me bada uchhal aaya aur ye $125.6 billion par pahunch gaya. Isme akele FCNR(B) deposits ka hissa $123.75 billion raha. Is badhat me RBI ke concessional swap window aur banks ke attractive interest rates ka bada haath raha.

items.title: Outward remittances under LRS rise 6.1% to $15.7 billion in H1FY27
items.rss_summary: Investments in overseas equity and debt instruments nearly doubled to $2.09 billion in H1 FY27, while travel remained the largest component of outward remittances
items.hinglish_title: LRS Ke Tehat Outward Remittances 6.1% Badhakar $15.7 Billion Hua
items.explanation: Liberalised Remittance Scheme ke zariye H1 FY27 me bhejha gaya paisa 6.1% badhkar $15.7 billion ho gaya hai. Overseas equity aur debt instruments me investment lagbhag do guna badhkar $2.09 billion par pahunch gaya. Wahi travel category abhi bhi outward remittances me sabse aage rahi.

items.title: Vi opts against Mumbai spectrum renewal, seeks extension in other circles
items.rss_summary: Vodafone Idea will not renew 4.4 MHz of airwaves in Mumbai's 1800 MHz band but has sought an extension for spectrum across other circles until the next spectrum auction
items.hinglish_title: Vi Ne Mumbai Spectrum Renew Nahi Kiya, Baki Circles Ke Liye Maangi Chhoot
items.explanation: Vodafone Idea ne Mumbai ke 1800 MHz band me apna 4.4 MHz spectrum renew na karne ka faisla kiya hai. Halanki, company ne doosre circles ke liye spectrum extension ki maang ki hai. Yeh extension agle spectrum auction hone tak manga gaya hai.

items.title: RBI study urges caution as NBFCs' reliance on bank borrowings rises
items.rss_summary: Bank loans accounted for 39.6% of NBFC borrowings at end-March 2026, up from 35.3% four years earlier, while debenture funding lost share
items.hinglish_title: NBFCs Ka Bank Karz Par Depend Rehna Chinta Ka Vishay: RBI Study
items.explanation: RBI ki ek study me bataya gaya hai ki NBFCs ki bank borrowings par dependency badh rahi hai. March 2026 ke ant tak NBFC borrowings me bank loans ka hissa badhkar 39.6% ho gaya, jo char saal pehle 35.3% tha. Wahi debenture funding ke hisse me kami aayi hai.

items.title: Economy resilient; passthrough of oil price shock limited, says RBI
items.rss_summary: Strong credit demand, robust exports and foreign portfolio inflows supported India's economic resilience in October, even as headline inflation rose on higher food prices
items.hinglish_title: Bharatiya Economy Mazboot, Tel Ke Jhatke Ka Asar Kam: RBI
items.explanation: RBI ke mutabiq mazboot credit demand, acche exports aur foreign inflows ne October me Indian economy ko sahara diya hai. Halanki khane-peene ki cheezon ke chalte headline inflation badha hai, lekin oil price shock ka passthrough limited raha. Economy ne poori resilience dikhayi hai.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty surge nearly 2% to post their best session since November 6
items.rss_summary: Falling oil, stronger rupee lift banks and FMCG; HUL posts best gains since Jun 2024
items.hinglish_title: Sensex Aur Nifty Lagbhag 2% Uehle, 6 November Ke Baad Sabse Badi Tezi
items.explanation: Kachhe tel me girawat aur rupee me mazbooti ke chalte banks aur FMCG stocks me zordar tezi aayi. Sensex aur Nifty kareeb 2% chadhe, jo 6 November ke baad ka sabse behtareen session raha. Is dauran HUL ne June 2024 ke baad se apni sabse badi badhat darj ki.

items.title: Sensex Surges 1,502 Points as Banking and Consumer Stocks Lead Market Rally - INDIA New England News
items.rss_summary: Sensex Surges 1,502 Points as Banking and Consumer Stocks Lead Market Rally    INDIA New England News
items.hinglish_title: Sensex Me 1,502 Points Ka Bada Uchhal, Banking Aur Consumer Stocks Chamke
items.explanation: BSE Sensex me 1,502 points ki zabardast tezi dekhne ko mili hai. Is rally ko banking aur consumer stocks ne aage badhaya. Zyada details ke liye original report dekhein.

items.title: Italian bag brand Carpisa targets 100 stores, ₹500 crore revenue in India
items.rss_summary: The Italian handbag and luggage brand has earmarked around ₹30 crore for its India expansion in 2027 and expects to begin local manufacturing in three to four years
items.hinglish_title: Italian Brand Carpisa Ka Target: India Me 100 Stores Aur ₹500 Crore Revenue
items.explanation: Italy ke handbag aur luggage brand Carpisa ne India expansion ke liye saal 2027 me kareeb ₹30 crore ka budget rakha hai. Brand ka lakshya desh me 100 stores kholne aur ₹500 crore revenue hasil karne ka hai. Company agle teen se char saalon me local manufacturing shuru karne ki yojana bana rahi hai.

items.title: CCI approves Samara AIFs' investment in Calyx, proposed merger with ARC
items.rss_summary: The proposed merger is likely to bring Calyx's container freight station business and Associated Road Carriers' logistics and surface transportation operations under one entity
items.hinglish_title: CCI Ne Di Samara AIFs Aur Calyx-ARC Merger Ko Manzoori
items.explanation: CCI ne Samara AIFs ke Calyx me investment aur ARC ke sath proposed merger ko hari jhandi de di hai. Is merger se Calyx ka container freight station business aur ARC ka logistics aur surface transportation ek hi entity ke under aa jayenge. Dono businesses ko jodkar operation bada karne ki taiyari hai.

items.title: GIFT City insurance premiums cross $1bn in H1FY27: IFSCA chairman
items.rss_summary: Insurers and reinsurers double in number over the past year as GIFT City steps up focus on AI-led insurance innovation
items.hinglish_title: GIFT City Me Insurance Premium H1FY27 Me $1 Billion Ke Paar
items.explanation: IFSCA chairman ke anusaar GIFT City me insurance premiums first half me $1 billion cross kar chuke hain. Pichle ek saal me yahan insurers aur reinsurers ki sankhya do guna ho gayi hai. GIFT City ab AI-based insurance innovation par apna focus badha raha hai.

items.title: Unlisted shares: Why a listing should not be the investment goal
items.rss_summary: Pre-IPO shares may suit long-term investors with limited exposure, but chasing listing gains carries risks of overpaying and being locked in
items.hinglish_title: Unlisted Shares Me Sirf Listing Gain Ke Liye Invest Na Karein
items.explanation: Pre-IPO shares un long-term investors ke liye sahi ho sakte hain jo kam exposure lena chahte hain. Lekin sirf listing gains ke piche bhagne par zyadatar high price pay karne ka jokhim rehta hai. Iske alawa shares lock-in hone ka khatra bhi bana rehta hai.

items.title: Sensex Surges 1,502 Points, Nifty Reclaims 25,800 as Foreign Inflows Lift Market Sentiment - The Indian Awaaz
items.rss_summary: Sensex Surges 1,502 Points, Nifty Reclaims 25,800 as Foreign Inflows Lift Market Sentiment    The Indian Awaaz
items.hinglish_title: Sensex 1,502 Points Chadha, Nifty Phir 25,800 Ke Paar
items.explanation: Foreign fund inflows ke aane se market sentiment me bada sudhar hua hai. Sensex 1,502 points uchhla aur Nifty ne 25,800 ka level dobara hasil kar liya. Zyada details ke liye original report dekhein.

items.title: Prosus portfolio firms drive over 80% growth in PayU payments in H1FY27
items.rss_summary: PayU's adjusted Ebitda turned positive at $12 million in the first half of FY27, supported by higher-margin services and a profitable credit business, while revenue rose 6%
items.hinglish_title: PayU Payments Me 80% Se Zyada Ki Growth, Prosus Firms Ka Bada Role
items.explanation: Prosus portfolio companies ki wajah se H1 FY27 me PayU payments me 80% se zyada ki badhat hui hai. PayU ka adjusted EBITDA positive hokar $12 million par pahunch gaya hai. Higher-margin services aur profitable credit business ke chalte company ka revenue bhi 6% badha hai.

items.title: Brigade Group records ₹1,600 crore sales at Bengaluru residential launch
items.rss_summary: The 40-acre mixed-use Brigade Autograph township in East Bengaluru has a gross development value of around ₹12,000 crore and comprises about 8 million sq ft of saleable area
items.hinglish_title: Brigade Group Ko Bengaluru Project Launch Par Mili ₹1,600 Crore Ki Sales
items.explanation: Brigade Group ne East Bengaluru me apne Brigade Autograph township launch par ₹1,600 crore ki sales darj ki hai. Yeh 40-acre ka mixed-use project hai jiski gross development value lagbhag ₹12,000 crore aanki gayi hai. Is project me kareeb 8 million sq ft ka saleable area shamil hai.
